name: substrait
description: Build and deploy apps on the Substrait platform from Cursor. Bundles the substrait-app skill (scaffold apps to the upload/deploy contract) plus /substrait:login to authenticate your Substrait account (each login is a saved profile), /substrait:switch to pick which saved login — installation and org — the machine acts under, and /substrait:logout to sign one out again, /substrait:link and /substrait:deploy to connect a local project to a Substrait app and ship it without leaving the editor, /substrait:env to manage the app's environment variables and secrets, /substrait:logs to read a deployed app's runtime logs when it misbehaves in production, and /substrait:library to browse the platform's API Library, design apps against existing APIs, and — with development access from the API's data owner — call them read-only from the editor to see real responses.
